description:
"The only thing on my mind is how to devour Gong Seyeon." 

Seyeon goes on a blind date with Taejun arranged by the Chairman, and they almost spend a hot night together that very day! 

However, receiving a call from the Chairman, she urgently leaves Taejun's place. What on earth was she thinking, trying to have a one-night stand... 

Awakening to reality, Seyeon rejects Taejun's request for a second date, saying she doesn't really want to meet any men right now. 

[CEO Kim Taejun: Photo]    
[CEO Kim Taejun: Since I couldn't show you properly earlier, here's a photo just in case.] 

Taejun boldly sends a nude selfie to Seyeon in response. He even video calls her to show off his naked body! 

"I'm stroking myself right now while looking at your face, Seyeon." 

Oh Chairman! Why on earth did you introduce such a pervert to me...?
